generated.label: generated
generated.provenance: Written by {model} on {when}. The frames are the record.

inspect.label: inspect
inspect.help: You can read what was recorded. No bodies were kept, so nothing can be replayed.

view.label: view
view.help: You can read what the agent asked, what the model returned, and what each tool was called with and returned.

fork.label: fork
fork.help: You can branch from any frame and run on, with tool results served from the recording.

retry.label: retry
retry.help: You can run the recording again and get the same frames.

readFailure.denied: You cannot see {section} in this workspace. Your roles do not include {permission}; an organization owner can grant it.
readFailure.pendingApproval: Access to {section} is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
readFailure.error: {section} could not be loaded: the control plane answered {code}. Nothing was changed, and runs kept recording.

mandateBar.title: Remaining authority · {measure} · {period} · {periodKey}
mandateBar.label: {measure}: {settled} settled, {remaining} remaining of {limit}
mandateBar.labelReserved: {measure}: {settled} settled, {reserved} reserved by calls in flight, {remaining} remaining of {limit}
mandateBar.overLimit: Drawn authority is past this limit: the ledger holds more than the limit now allows, which is what lowering a limit does to authority already drawn. The settled and reserved figures say where it sits.

sourceFilename.name: Source name
sourceFilename.hint: Enter to apply. Escape to cancel. This updates the name in the source.
sourceFilename.invalid: Use a valid lowercase name with hyphens, and check that the source can be read.

error.title: This page could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered {answer}. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.incidentNotBacked: Oxagen cannot open an incident from this page yet.

denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.requestNotBacked: Oxagen cannot send a request for a role yet.
denied.policyNotRecorded: The refusal does not record which policy decided it.

desktopDownloads.title: Install the Oxagen app
desktopDownloads.lead: Install it first, on the machine the agent runs on. The app puts the oxagen and tacho commands on PATH, and enrollment runs through them.
